explanation: Persons who were responsible for protecting and preserving the sanctuary in the temple, as well as controlling access to it.
A group of Levites descended from Korah, a relative of Moses and Aaron. They had special duties related to temple service.
One of the three branches of the tribe of Levi, also known as the Merarites. They were responsible for certain parts of the tabernacle and later the temple.
A Levite and temple gatekeeper who housed the ark of the covenant in his home for three months before it was moved to Jerusalem.
A method for organizing the work among temple workers by dividing them into groups that served in periods or shifts.
A practice used to decide important matters or allocate responsibilities, based on the belief that God controlled the outcome.
Persons who were responsible for collecting money and gifts for the temple and the priesthood.
